verdict.rationale: Grafana Cloud's own Adaptive Telemetry suite is documented as a data-volume and cost-management capability: it identifies valuable data and aggregates the rest. However, the evidence does not show developer-controlled trace or log sampling, and nothing documents retention tiers. Missing for 10: explicit trace sampling configuration, log sampling/drop controls, configurable retention tiers or periods, per-signal developer control, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can control trace/log sampling and retention tiers to manage data volume deliberately

citations.quote: Grafana Cloud’s Adaptive Telemetry suite automatically identifies the data worth your attention and aggregates the rest, cutting your telemetry costs by up to 80%.
Simplify cost management with Adaptive Telemetry
